A full card image re-made by the Players Committee with the mark D-E2 in the lower border (29 July 2026). Its words are the Players Committee's errata, not Decipher's.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Dagobah-D-flagship-PC-Errata-2026-D-E2-card-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Flagship (PC 2023-06 D-E1 card)]] (18 June 2023): The game text changes: “about to be” is added after “free). If starship”. The whole card is drawn again at 745 × 1039 pixels with the corrected text and the mark “D-E2” in the lower border.

The whole 2023-06 D-E1 card image and the whole 2026 D-E2 card image, both scaled to 500 pixels wide; nothing else is edited.
